citation.title: Visible spectroscopy of highly charged tungsten ions with the JET charge exchange diagnostic
citation.authors: Thorman A, Litherland-Smith E, Menmuir S, Hawkes N, O'Mullane M, Delabie E, Lomanowski B, Fontdecaba J M, Scully S and JET Contributors

topic: Tungsten charge-exchange and suspected M1 lines contaminating impurity CXS spectra (C VI 529 nm, Ne X 525 nm, He II) on JET with the ITER-like wall.
own_question: Which visible tungsten lines appear in JET CXS spectra, and how do they affect impurity Ti and rotation fits?
actual_method_and_evidence: JET opposed-view and vertical CXS spectra (text only, no figures inspected) were used to tabulate W CX lines against a relativistic Rydberg formula, plus 21 suspected passive M1 lines compared with LHD, EBIT and theory. Includes a force-balance argument for W rotation offsets and a simulated Zeeman linewidth correction. It does not quantify the error in fitted carbon or neon Ti.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: In tungsten-wall devices, reported carbon-impurity CXS temperatures depend on spectral fitting choices. Overlapping W39+/W46+ CX lines near 529 nm can bias fitted C VI width or position unless they are included in the fit model.
claim_checks.original_pdf_locator: p.3 bullets; p.5 sect.2.1; p.6 figs 2-3 captions
claim_checks.qualification: Shown for JET ILW, not KSTAR. The bias is described qualitatively, not quantified. It concerns impurity Ti, not main-ion Ti.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: CES-reported impurity temperature is a fit-derived quantity, conditional on modelling assumptions such as Zeeman broadening and nuisance lines, rather than an independent truth.
claim_checks.original_pdf_locator: p.7 eqs 5-7, sect.2.2; fig.4 caption p.7
claim_checks.qualification: The Zeeman correction is a simulation-based approximation, said to be small for light impurities at modest temperature.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Not applicable; this is offline spectral analysis with no timing or latency information.
validation_if_relevant: Line identification uses Rydberg predictions, active versus passive views, and literature cross-checks. There is no fit-error validation.
forbidden_inferences: That KSTAR CES carbon spectra contain these W lines
That any quantified Ti bias was demonstrated
That this source addresses nowcasting, real-time use, BES or ECEI
That CES labels are physical truth
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Supports the framing of reported carbon CES Ti as a fit-dependent label in metal-wall plasmas. The citation should be limited to that point.
